scope: Clarify the ordered task contract and completion conditions for four RMBench tasks without exposing seeds, world coordinates, robot-arm assignments, or hidden task answers.
design_rules: Preserve the task objective and object relationships defined by the original RMBench instruction.
State the required order of task stages, the identities that must remain continuous, and the observable completion conditions.
Do not include environment seeds, fixed world coordinates, task-specific arm assignments, low-level motion commands, or hidden correct configurations.
Apply the same instruction text to every evaluated method in this condition.
Report this clarified-instruction condition separately from vanilla RMBench.

rearrange_blocks.rationale: Make the initial block identities, empty mat, required stage order, and final placement explicit.

swap_blocks.rationale: Make the initial block-to-tray identities, temporary-buffer role, capacity constraint, and button timing explicit.

swap_T.rationale: Make clear that each complete initial pose contains both position and orientation and must be assigned to the other T-block.

battery_try.rationale: State that distinct orientation combinations must be tested through observable dashboard feedback without revealing the hidden successful combination.
